subject: mathematics
concept: Writing algebraic expressions from word descriptions (e.g. 'three more than a number')
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds an expression by combining a mystery-box quantity with counted objects
exercise.pictorial: Student matches pictured phrases to their algebraic expression
exercise.abstract: Student translates written phrases into algebraic expressions (e.g. n + 3, 2n, n - 5)

misconception_flags: reverses subtraction order (writes 5 - n instead of n - 5, or vice versa, against the phrase meaning)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
